neighbours.label: tentative or optional qualifiers (probable, possibly, trend, preferred, suggestive)
fire: The X-ray showed a probable fracture of the left wrist.
Higher doses showed a trend towards better outcomes in the study.
A master's degree is preferred but not required for the role.
The data provide suggestive evidence of a link with diet.
The storm will possibly reach the coast by Friday.
Experience with Python is an advantage for this position.
Applicants should preferably speak some Spanish.
Doctors listed a possible infection as the cause.
quiet: The X-ray showed a clear fracture of the left wrist.
Higher doses produced much better outcomes in the study.
A master's degree is required for the role.
The data provide strong evidence of a link with diet.
The storm will definitely reach the coast by Friday.
Experience with Python is mandatory for this position.
Doctors confirmed an infection as the cause.

notes: distinction: hedged/optional vs definite/required; negative pole side.
